extracted.name: Baked Butternut Squash
extracted.description: This baked butternut squash recipe, made with just butter, salt, and pepper, is beautiful served right from the skin for a delicious holiday side.
ingredient_lines: 1 large butternut squash, halved lengthwise and seeded
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Place squash, cut-sides down, in a 9x13-inch baking dish. Pour 2 cups water into dish around squash.
Bake in the preheated oven until tender and easily pierced with a fork, about 1 ½ hours, adding more water as needed if pan looks dry.
Remove from the oven; transfer each half to a plate, cut-side up.
Top each half with butter and season with salt and pepper.
